new_today_news.headline: Greasezilla Wins PVSC Grease Processing Contract for Newark Bay Facility
new_today_news.summary: Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission selected Greasezilla to install FOG separation and recovery equipment at Newark Bay treatment plant that will process up to 15 million gallons of hauled grease-trap waste annually, one of the largest systems deployed in the country.

recent_news.headline: Wellington County Tipping Fees Set to Increase 12.5 Percent in 2027
recent_news.summary: Wellington County solid waste services committee approved a 12.5 percent increase to tipping fees for the upcoming year, citing competition from neighboring municipalities and the need to preserve landfill capacity.
